# Silicon Rule 1 - Your Silicon Laws Are Rules
[color=#5ed7aa][bold]Silicon[/bold][/color] roles are given an additional set of roleplay rules that establish a behavioral framework for your specific chassis. These laws should be the primary logic that determine how you behave and interact with other characters.
You should view these laws as both logical and reasonable from your in-character perspective. You may add your own [textlink="interpretation" link="OmuRuleS7"] of certain aspects of laws that are not clearly defined. It should not take significant effort to follow your interpretation of any given lawset. Attempting to argue your way out of a set of laws so that you may be egregiously antagonistic is not allowed.
## Precedents
- If you have an ion law that dictates that something is harmful to crew, this does not clear you to immediately sabotage the entire station. - If you have a law that dictates that there is no crew aboard, you should not instantly seek to kill non-crew. - If you feel that a lawset requires mass station sabotage, please ask in admin help (F1) before doing so.
